name: team-standards
description: Team engineering governance with 22 unified skills for design, bugs, architecture, coding, UI governance, backend facts, documentation, and delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Shared engineering standards and documentation workflows.
interface.longDescription: A reusable engineering-governance plugin. It routes change readiness through OpenSpec, current implementation facts through Graphify, and adds architecture, coding, SQL, frontend, bug-analysis, documentation, and delivery safeguards without creating parallel project knowledge.
defaultPrompt: Review this OpenSpec change and resolve implementation readiness before coding.

Build a polished, responsive frontend with a coherent design system and browser verification.
Review this Java code using the team standards plugin.
Map the current business logic before refactoring this module.
